bodyHtml:
Welcome to our very first Featured Patient of the Month for June, 2023!  We will select one patient every month who has either undergone a surgical procedure, gastric balloon, or a medical weight loss treatment with JourneyLite Physicians.  Our goal is to showcase some of our most successful patients so that they can be an inspiration to others in their weight loss journey.  Congrats to Ann G. who has had a fabulous result after her gastric sleeve in 2022!

*Patients must go through a brief application process and if posted have given permission for us to post their information publicly and whether or not we can use their full name.

Name
Ann G.
Program:
Surgery
Surgery:
gastric sleeve
Surgery date or program start date:
January
Year:
2022
My highest adult weight was (lbs):
353
My current weight is (lbs):
232
I first noticed that my weight was a problem:
As a child
Tell us in your own words how your weight has affected your life:
The bullying began in grade school . I was teased on a daily basis for being over weight . I remember hiding in the rest room and peaking out the door till all the students were upstairs .I made a mad dash to my class room . .By doing this I was able to avoid the bully and avoid getting teased in front of my class mates.. I often did not make it to the classroom before the bell stopped ringing . Then I experienced getting in trouble from my teacher for being tardy. This was the beginning of my very low self esteem/self confidence and depression which followed me into adulthood. It held me back from pursuing the life I deserved ,because I didn’t believe in me or believe I was worthy . I could write a book… Who knows maybe I will !!
Tell us how surgery and/or medication has helped you get control of your weight issues:
Sometimes.. you have to hit bottom before you can change. On the way home from a family vacation the stewardess on my plane yelled to the front of the plane.” I need a seat belt extension on seat 15 A. “I wanted to crawl under my seat. I had reached an all time high of 353 pounds .I was in so much pain both emotionally and physically . I wanted to die . When I got home from the trip I made the decision to lose the weight . I started the next day and never turned back. I lost 60 pounds with the help of the Journey Lite Team..
Jan 26 ,2022 Dr .Curry performed my surgury with no complications. . The team has been very supportive..
I would still like to lose another 50 pounds . I’m confident I will accomplish this goal. I am able to travel comfortably … No seat belt extension ! Go me !!
I can cross my legs !! I can walk miles.. I can ride a bike !!
I can get onto the back of the boat without being hoisted up !
I can snorkel ! I can swim continuous !! I enjoy walking miles on the bike path with my granddaughter !! I sleep good .. I don’t snore any longer . My labs are much improved. I can wear cute clothes & I wore a bikini for the first time this year. I wish that I would have been able to get the surgury sooner . I was a self pay so we had to pay out of pocket. I believe the surgury saved my life just in the knick of time.
Tell us about the support you have received from the team at JourneyLite and how it has impacted your success:
The team at Journey Lite has been fantastic and very supportive. I have felt comfortable every step of the way. The process was seamless and I have referred many to Dr . Curry .
What’s one thing you can do now that you couldn’t before you lost the weight:
My entire life has changed !!
But the main thing is that I am physically fit & active & able to walk miles !! Go me 
Optional Comments:
Big Thank you to Dr Curry & team !!
